sleeper.name: Sleeper/RotoWire
sleeper.access_status: Publicly reachable but not documented in Sleeper's official API reference.
sleeper.scoring: Projected counting stats scored with the league's Sleeper settings.

espn.name: ESPN
espn.access_status: Publicly reachable ESPN fantasy player pool endpoint; undocumented and isolated behind a fallback adapter.
espn.scoring: ESPN projected counting stats mapped to the league's Sleeper scoring settings.
espn.retention: Only the league-specific consensus and coverage metadata are persisted; raw ESPN projection rows are not republished.

stathead.name: StatHead open model
stathead.model: Open weekly model based on season PPG, opponent defense versus position, venue, and available market environment.
stathead.license: StatHead model outputs are published for reuse; code is MIT licensed.
stathead.scoring: PPR points adjusted by the player's Sleeper league-to-PPR factor when available.

methodology.player_season_projection: Equal-weight available-source consensus across Sleeper/RotoWire, ESPN, and StatHead.
methodology.player_weekly_projection: Individual weekly consensus projections retain source coverage, disagreement, and confidence so changes over time can be audited.
methodology.team_season_projection: Consensus full-season lineup projection is available immediately. The weekly aggregate becomes authoritative after all 18 weekly files are populated.
methodology.projected_record: Compares optimized weekly lineup scores for each scheduled matchup; it is a deterministic projected record, not a probability simulation.
